![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

For efficiency, you can use a single `jq` command to extract all the required values from the manifest file. This avoids spawning multiple `jq` processes for the same file. Using `jq`'s `@sh` format specifier ensures that the values are correctly shell-escaped, making the `eval` safe.

```
eval "$(jq -r '"name=" + (.metadata.name // .rojig.name | @sh), "summary=" + (.metadata.summary // .rojig.summary | @sh), "ref=" + (.ref // "" | @sh)' < "${flattened_manifest}")"
```
